---
name: Bug report
about: A skill routed wrongly, gave bad instructions, or contradicted the OpenKey docs
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Skill and version**
Which skill, and the version from `VERSION`.

**Host and version**
Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, other, with its version.

**What you asked**
The message you sent, as close to verbatim as you can share. Remove anything private.

**What happened**
What the agent did, what it changed in your files, and what it should have done instead.

**Error details, if any**
The error `code` and the `X-OpenKey-Request-Id` response header. Never paste your API key.
